commits.subject: feat(api): add Discord OAuth staff sessions
commits.description: Allow authorized Even Legion staff to sign in to the future management portal with Discord while Arbiter verifies current staff membership before every protected request. Sign-in now uses short-lived, revocable sessions, exact approved browser origins and redirects, and protections against replay and cross-site requests; Discord tokens and secrets stay inside the API and are not stored. This delivers the API authentication flow, while the portal interface and production deployment arrive in later work; no Discord commands or current member workflows change yet.
